recipe.normalization: The installed record generator emitted write-file operations without preimage hashes and with unused empty search/replace fields. Added SHA-256 preimages from the exact recorded Git baseline for the 28 existing files and removed unused fields. The 13 new-file operations have no preimage_hash; their absence is established by the fresh exact-base replay fixtures. Product content and canonical patch were unchanged.

tpatch_verification.detail: The verifier cannot materialize the hard parent's canonical patch at the verification baseline. Verifying that parent independently on unchanged main also fails its historical/current canonical-patch and preimage checks, although its recipe replay passes. This feature's own exact-base recipe and canonical patch were independently replayed successfully. Do not alter truthful dependencies or rewrite historical artifacts to suppress the inherited failure.
tpatch_verification.later_touch_warnings: The tool reports older whole-file owners on shared paths. Exact-base preimages and complete approved postimage comparisons were used; no older feature artifacts were modified.

approved_safety_policy.managed_mode: explicit opt-in; legacy directory templates remain separate
approved_safety_policy.role_selection: persist independent worktree and orchestrator sources and rendering provenance
approved_safety_policy.obsolete_file_consent: exact-path warning and default-No confirmation; explicit unattended consent never overrides ownership or edits
approved_safety_policy.preservation: preserve before mutation; clean verified old copies only after successful publication; retain evidence on conflict or failure
approved_safety_policy.open_descriptor_limit: automatic cleanup does not protect writes arriving later through already-open descriptors after final successful verification
approved_safety_policy.checkout: one physical checkout; session-owned temporary context only
